name: Lasagna Noodles
siboNotes: Wheat-based pasta is high in fructans and should be avoided or consumed in very small portions during SIBO treatment. Consider gluten-free alternatives made from rice or corn.
preparationTips: Cook al dente to potentially reduce FODMAP content slightly
Rinse after cooking to remove excess starch
Layer thinly in lasagna to minimize portion size
Combine with low-FODMAP vegetables to bulk up the dish
alternatives: Gluten-free lasagna noodles made from rice flour
